title: supertask once never promo
rule: Supertask button once; never for promo; link-style button for rare actions. Supertask launches the page’s main task (apply / calculator / wizard). Not for promotion (use feature patterns). Primary still ≤1 per page (dual-cite Actions). Link buttons = infrequent (restart calculator) with a larger hit area than a text link. Danger only when consequences are real.
pass_when: At most one supertask; it starts the main task; not used for promo; ≤1 primary; link-style only for rare actions with a larger hit area; danger only for real consequences.
fail_when: Two supertasks; supertask used as promo; two primaries; danger used without real consequences.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
do_not_claim: A second primary class that beats Actions one-primary.
